messages.author: Freddy Bernal
messages.body:
Dear Amber community,
After having installed the CPU version of Amber 22 (with update 4) on an Ubuntu workstation, following the manual, a ran the
tests. As a result, 5 file comparisons failed (2 of which can be ignored). The documentation states that differences (in the *.dif
files) may involve round-off in the final digit printed. Thus, two more issues could be ignored (one even have no differences at
all but still registered as failure, i.e. MMPBSA_Decomp_Residue). However, for nve, the difference is not only in the final digit.
What can I do? should I simply ignore that?
